title: Help need to install nightly build on jelly phone
symptom: User is new and asks for guidance on how to install the latest nightly build on a jelly phone.
fix: Go to jamorham.github.io, next to the QR code click on 'Nightly', find the newest release, open assets, download apk file, open it (file manager, download list). When Android asks you to confirm that this came from a trusted source, confirm, install.
